ego.en: So it's never been about ego. It's never been about me.

ego.en: To indulge them. Well, if you're doing it to just feel better about yourself, that could be strengthening your personality and your ego and could be creating a more fragile personality um you know one one big anxiety result for me is just ruminating on death i think that's a good one you're gonna die it's all going to zero you cannot take anything with you and i know this is trite and i know the the we don't spend enough time thinking about the big questions we kind of give up on them when we're very very young you know a little child might ask the big questions like why are we here?
ego.zh: 为了放纵它们。嗯，如果你这样做只是为了让自己感觉更好，那可能会强化你的个性和自我，并可能创造一个更脆弱的个性。你知道，对我来说，一个巨大的焦虑来源就是对死亡的沉思，我觉得这很好。你会死，一切都会归零，你什么都带不走。我知道这很陈词滥调，我知道我们没有花足够的时间思考大问题，我们在很小的时候就放弃了它们。你知道，一个小孩子可能会问大问题，比如“我们为什么在这里？”

ego.en: What I'm specifically referring to that is if you're thinking about your personality and your ego and the character of you, and you're obsessing over that, that's where a lot of depression and unhappiness sort of lingers and and gets cultivated uh so uh thinking about woe is me this happened to me that happened to me i have this personality i have this issue i deserve this i didn't get that that's you're just strengthening a little beast in there that is insatiable and that's where i think a lot of unhappiness comes from what's the beast it's the ego but that word is so overused that i kind of I hate to use the word, but it's a recurrent collection of thoughts that are very self-obsessed and will never be satisfied.
ego.zh: 我特别指的是，如果你一直在思考你的个性、你的自我以及你的性格，并对此念念不忘，那么很多抑郁和不快乐往往就是从这里滋生并被培养出来的。比如总是想着“我真可怜”、“这事发生在我身上”、“那事也发生在我身上”、“我有这种个性”、“我有这个问题”、“我理应得到这个”、“我没得到那个”，你其实是在喂养内心那个贪得无厌的小怪兽，我认为很多不快乐都源于此。什么是怪兽？就是“自我”（ego），但这个词被用得太滥了，我不太想用，但它就是一连串非常自恋、永远无法满足的重复性思维。
